# ASTRA ARCHITECTURE AUDIT & PRODUCTION OS TRANSFORMATION BLUEPRINT

**Generated by Antigravity Principal Architect & Systems Engineering Team**  
**Project:** ASTRA (Autonomous System for Task Routing & Agentic Intelligence)  
**Date:** August 2026  
**Status:** Audit Complete — Ready for Incremental Migration  

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Audit Overview

This audit document evaluates the complete existing codebase of **ASTRA** (`e:\EV my personal assistant`), identifies functional components, highlights security vulnerabilities and technical debt, and specifies the migration strategy to transform ASTRA into a production-grade, modular, secure, multimodal, agentic personal AI operating system (JARVIS/FRIDAY class).

---

## 2. Comprehensive Codebase Audit (18 Diagnostic Vectors)

### 1. Frontend Framework
* **Stack:** React 19.2.8 with TypeScript (TS 6.0.2 compiler config), Vite 8.2.0, TailwindCSS v4.3.3 (`@tailwindcss/vite`), Framer Motion 13.0.0, Lucide React 1.29.0, Three.js 0.185.1 (`@react-three/fiber` 9.7.0, `@react-three/drei` 10.7.8).
* **Architecture:** Component-driven single-page application with dual visual paradigms:
  1. 3D WebGL Hologram Orb & Lunar shaders (`EvaCanvasContainer.tsx`, `EvaHologram3D.tsx`, `EvaShaders.ts`).
  2. Glassmorphic Desktop Workspace UI (`AstraDesktopInterface.tsx`, `OSDashboard.tsx`).

### 2. Backend Architecture
* **Stack:** Node.js Express 4.18.2 REST API + native `ws` 8.13.0 WebSocket server on port `8990` (`server/index.js`).
* **Endpoints:**
  * `GET /api/health` — System health & OS telemetry metrics.
  * `POST /api/execute-cmd` — Direct host shell command execution.
  * `POST /api/automate` — Application launcher, file reader/writer, keystroke/clipboard injector, audio volume control.
  * `POST /api/automation/search-song` — YouTube video scraper.
  * `POST /api/automation/play-song` — Local playback automation trigger.
  * `WS /ev-kernel` — Bidirectional WebSocket IPC bridge emitting 1Hz telemetry updates and receiving commands.

### 3. Database & Storage
* **Provider:** Supabase (PostgreSQL 15+ cluster on AWS `hzvsrqhfurghzkfdpxlt.supabase.co`).
* **Extensions:** `pgvector` extension enabled (`vector(1536)`).
* **Tables Defined (`supabase_schema.sql`):**
  * `conversations` (id, user_id, title, timestamps)
  * `messages` (id, conversation_id, sender, content, model_used, timestamps)
  * `memories` (id, user_id, content, category, tags, importance, timestamps)
  * `rag_documents` (id, title, content, category, embedding, metadata, timestamps)
  * `tasks` (id, title, status, priority, due_date, timestamps)
  * `projects` (id, name, status, progress, description, timestamps)
  * `system_logs` (id, event_type, details, status, timestamps)

### 4. Authentication & Security Layer
* **Status:** Anonymous public tier (`@supabase/supabase-js` anon key in frontend bundle).
* **RLS Policies:** Open (`USING (true) WITH CHECK (true)`). No user-level isolation or cryptographic session validation.
* **Backend Security:** No API key, bearer token, or OAuth validation on Express REST or WebSocket endpoints.

### 5. Current AI Providers & Model Routing
* **Client-Side Direct Integrations:**
  * OpenAI (`gpt-4o`) via `https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions`
  * Groq Cloud (`llama-3.3-70b-versatile`) via `https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions`
  * Google Gemini (`gemini-1.5-flash`) via `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-1.5-flash`
  * DeepSeek AI (`deepseek-chat`) via `https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions`
  * Ollama (`ollama-local`) placeholder for offline CUDA/Metal execution.
* **Routing Mechanism:** Hardcoded heuristic string matching (`src/services/aiEngine.ts`) with fallback chains.

### 6. Voice & Wake-Word Implementation
* **Speech-to-Text (STT):** Browser Web Speech API (`webkitSpeechRecognition` / `SpeechRecognition`) continuous mode.
* **Text-to-Speech (TTS):** Browser `window.speechSynthesis` (`SpeechSynthesisUtterance`) with markdown stripping and audio click sound effects.
* **Wake Word:** Web Speech API keyword listener polling for "Hey Astra", "Astra", "Eva".
* **Interruption:** Keyword detection for "stop", "quiet", "silence" calling `speechSynthesis.cancel()`.

### 7. Current APIs & Integrations
* Browser Web Speech & MediaDevices (Webcam/Mic)
* Free IP Geolocation via `https://ipapi.co/json`
* Free Weather via Open-Meteo API (`https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast`)
* YouTube HTML scraping regex parsing (`ytInitialData`)
* Local Win32 shell automation via `child_process.exec` (PowerShell & Cmd)

### 8. Environment Variable Configuration
* **Frontend (`.env`):**
  * `VITE_OPENAI_API_KEY`, `VITE_DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, `VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY`, `VITE_GROQ_API_KEY`, `VITE_SUPABASE_URL`, `VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`
* **Vulnerability:** Exposing `VITE_*` API keys in client-side Vite bundles is unsafe for production. Keys must reside exclusively in backend environment configurations.

### 9. Deployment Configuration
* Single package bundle built via `vite build` to `dist/`.
* No Docker containerization, no reverse proxy, no supervisor process config, no CI/CD workflow files.

### 10. Existing Astra Features (Working & Intact)
* ✅ 3D Holographic Canvas with Three.js lunar shaders & reactive waveforms.
* ✅ Full Desktop Workspace UI (Tabs: Home, Messages, Tasks, Notes, Settings, Knowledge RAG, Camera Vision).
* ✅ Real-time System Telemetry streaming (CPU, RAM, Network, Battery).
* ✅ Local App Launcher (VS Code, Explorer, Spotify, Chrome, Terminal, Calc).
* ✅ Local File Read / Write via backend Express IPC.
* ✅ Clipboard Read / Write & Keystroke injection simulation.
* ✅ Multi-Provider AI Query Execution (Groq, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek) with fallback.
* ✅ In-Memory TF-IDF Semantic RAG & Vector similarity simulation.
* ✅ Supabase Postgres persistence for messages, memories, tasks.
* ✅ Natural conversational responses with "Yes, boss" persona styling.

### 11. Broken / Incomplete / Simulated Functionality
* ⚠️ **YouTube Video Scraper:** Parsing `ytInitialData` from raw HTML breaks intermittently due to YouTube anti-bot headers. Needs official YouTube v3 API or robust fallback.
* ⚠️ **Simulated Agent Orchestration:** `aiEngine.ts` contains static agent cards (`getInitialAgents()`) rather than dynamic autonomous agent loops (ResearchAgent, CodingAgent, SystemAgent, etc.).
* ⚠️ **Simulated Vision:** `cameraVisionService.ts` generates rule-based mock object descriptions when Gemini Vision API is not directly wired with image buffer payloads.
* ⚠️ **Trusted Automation Bypass:** `safetyGatekeeper.ts` defaults to `trustedAutomationEnabled: true`, bypassing confirmation prompts for non-critical shell commands.

### 12. Duplicate Code & Redundancies
* `src/services/voiceVisionEngine.ts` duplicates speech recognition & synthesis logic found in `src/services/speech/stt.ts` and `src/services/speech/tts.ts`.
* Multiple overlapping UI dashboards (`src/components/ui/OSDashboard.tsx` and `src/components/astra/AstraDesktopInterface.tsx`).

### 13. Security Vulnerabilities
* 🔴 **Critical — Unrestricted Host Command Execution:** Backend `/api/execute-cmd` and `/api/automate` run raw shell commands directly on the host system without authorization, input sanitization, or container sandboxing.
* 🔴 **Critical — Secrets Exposure:** AI provider keys are prefixed with `VITE_` and bundled into client JavaScript.
* 🟠 **High — Open Supabase RLS:** Row-level security permits global anonymous read/write access.
* 🟠 **High — Direct Prompt Injection:** Raw external search results, files, and clipboard contents are interpolated directly into LLM prompts without sanitization or defensive framing.

### 14. Technical Debt & Typing Gaps
* Backend is written in vanilla JS without TypeScript definitions or schema validation (e.g. Zod).
* Intent parsing in `App.tsx` relies on hardcoded string prefix matches (`if (lower.startsWith('open '))`) rather than LLM-driven structured tool calling and intent classification.

### 15. Existing UI System
* Polished futuristic visual design with dark palette (`#05030d`, cyan/amber accents), glassmorphic panels, animated SVG voice lines, and interactive 3D orb.

### 16. Git Status & Branches
* Active branch: `main` (clean working directory, synchronized with `origin/main`).

### 17. Build & Test Baseline
* Build (`tsc -b && vite build`): **Passing** (dist output ~1.5MB JS / 106KB CSS).
* Linter (`oxlint`): **Passing** (0 errors).
* Automated Test Runner: None configured yet.

## 4. Phased Implementation Roadmap

* **Phase 1 (Audit & Preservation):** Architecture audit (completed) & creation of isolated migration branch `astra-ultra`.
* **Phase 2 (Backend Security & Model Router):** Migrate AI orchestration and secrets to secure backend router with official APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Groq, DeepSeek, Ollama), structured tool calling, and backend API vault.
* **Phase 3 (Agent Orchestrator & Task Engine):** Implement real multi-agent execution loop (`AgentManager`, `TaskManager`, `ResearchAgent`, `CodingAgent`, `SystemAgent`, `BrowserAgent`, `CreativeAgent`, `RoboticsAgent`) with real step-by-step planning and artifact generation.
* **Phase 4 (Permission Engine & Isolated Sandbox):** Multi-tier permission gatekeeper (READ, SAFE_ACTION, WRITE, EXECUTE, DEPLOY, DELETE, PHYSICAL) and command policy isolation.
* **Phase 5 (Memory Engine & Knowledge Graph):** Unified episodic, semantic (pgvector), project, and relationship graph memory.
* **Phase 6 (Voice & Multimodal Vision):** Low-latency voice pipeline, real wake-word engine, screen & camera multimodal analysis via official Gemini/OpenAI vision APIs.
* **Phase 7 (Integrations & Credential Center):** Official OAuth/API integration hub (`/settings/integrations`, `/settings/models`, GitHub, Google, Supabase, Vercel, Figma, Spotify).
* **Phase 8 (Device Abstraction & Future Robotics API):** Hardware abstraction layer (`RoboticsController`, `SuitController`, `SpatialMap`, Digital Twin simulation).
* **Phase 9 (UI Refinement & Testing):** Premium futuristic HUD UI, full end-to-end acceptance tests, test suites, and comprehensive documentation suite.
